projects.title: Selected work

v-okamihu.title: V Okamihu
v-okamihu.description: Booking platform for a client, built in a team. I built the reservation calendar with server-validated slot capacities, filters synced between Pinia and the URL, and the API for lecturers, services and reservations.

topiqu.title: Topiqu
topiqu.description: Multi-tenant publishing SaaS with an AI-assisted editor. I lead development in a two-engineer team: 90 data models with 160+ access policies in ZenStack, article generation that survives restarts and deploys, Stripe billing and ~600 test files. The repository is public.

fastproject.title: FastProject
fastproject.description: Project management tool built for Neowara: React and Hono on Cloudflare Workers (D1, KV, R2), two-way Asana sync, capacity planning and RBAC.

nimblo.title: Nimblo
nimblo.description: Proposal generator built for Neowara: a React SPA on Vite with a Hono API on Cloudflare Workers, AI template analysis, dynamic variables and a Fireflies integration.

posthog.title: PostHog – merged PR #58224
posthog.description: Fixed lost per-tab UI state in PostHog's multi-tab navigation (React, Kea). I moved the state outside the scene lifecycle, fixed URL restore in Events and Sessions and added cleanup on tab close. 15 files, reviewed and merged.

bio.intro: I'm a full-stack TypeScript engineer from Czechia. I've been building web applications with Vue and Nuxt since 2024, and for the last year and a half mostly Topiqu, a multi-tenant SaaS where I lead development in a two-engineer team, from the data model to production infrastructure.
bio.work: I do my best work when I can take a feature from design to production and keep looking after it. I keep authorization in the data layer, contracts typed and changes small enough to review well. I use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) every day, and every change still has to pass types, tests, CI and my own review.
bio.personal: Outside of code I run, lift and read fantasy, mostly The Witcher and The Lord of the Rings.
